scheme.concept: Orientation-aware directional zoning: Master bedroom in Southwest (Nairrutya), Kitchen in Southeast (Agneya), Puja/Living in Northeast/East.
feature_summary: Topology concept: Orientation-aware directional zoning: Master bedroom in Southwest (Nairrutya), Kitchen in Southeast (Agneya), Puja/Living in Northeast/East.
Private rooms are distributed across front and rear zones.
The circulation hall is positioned along a side.
Solver-produced shared-wall relationships: entry foyer–master bedroom, bathroom–entry foyer, entry foyer–hallway, living room–master bedroom, bathroom–living room, dining–kitchen.
Vastu rules satisfied: Entry Foyer in Northeast; Kitchen in Southeast; Balcony / Terrace in West.
Vastu rule violations: Attached Bath 2 in Center (expected West / Northwest); Common Bathroom in Center (expected West / Northwest); Circulation Hall in Northeast (expected South / West / Northwest).
